threat_event: Tampered or counterfeit products enter distribution through a compromised or dishonest supplier and reach DoD, reseller, and consumer customers
threat_source: Cybercriminals or dishonest brokers in the supply chain
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Serial validation at 4 of 9 DCs; 180 brokers, 61 unassessed; firmware checks only at integration centers; Section 889 block on federal orders only
affected_asset_or_process: BP-LW01 receiving; BP-ID03 integration; BP-OR01 storefront
existing_controls: Authorized-source rule for federal orders; approved supplier list; integration center firmware checks
treatment_plan: Serial validation at all 9 DCs; broker assessments; firmware integrity checks at receiving; group product-integrity playbook (P08)

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services and stops fulfillment in every division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One WMS instance for 9 DCs; shared identity and integration layers; ransomware scenario on the WMS replica never tested
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable backups; quarterly WMS restore tests
treatment_plan: WMS ransomware recovery test including the replica; segment WMS tiers; isolated recovery account

threat_event: CUI is exposed or mishandled outside the Federal Fulfillment Enclave
threat_source: External attacker, insider error, or SaaS vendor breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 3,200 CUI files in the commercial ERP and collaboration tenant; no DLP on CUI markings; IC-2 lab route to a corporate VLAN
existing_controls: FFE in a government-community region; CUI roster; FIPS-validated encryption in the FFE
treatment_plan: Purge and block CUI outside the FFE; DLP on CUI markings; move prime exchange to the government-community tenant; close the IC-2 route

threat_event: The group fails to reach CMMC Level 2 (C3PAO) status before Phase 2 option periods and loses integration subcontracts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported 2025 SPRS score; non-POA&M requirements open (3.1.20, 3.10.3); assessment window 2027-01
affected_asset_or_process: BP-ID03 federal integration (about $570 million a year)
existing_controls: CMMC program office; FFE; readiness consultant
treatment_plan: Close all non-POA&M requirements by 2026-12-15; readiness check; correct the SPRS entry on counsel advice

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses a notice deadline (DIBNet 72 hours, Section 889 1 business day, Form 8-K Item 1.05)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix never exercised; 2 DIBNet certificate holders in one location
existing_controls: POL-03; disclosure committee charter; SOC 24x7
treatment_plan: Cross-division tabletop with the matrix; 2 more certificate holders; out-of-band contact list

threat_event: Control failures in Logistics systems go unseen because inheritance from group controls is undocumented
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No inheritance record for WMS, TMS, OT; 3PL SOC 2 description blocked
existing_controls: Common control catalog; group internal audit
treatment_plan: Logistics inheritance matrix; annual confirmation

threat_event: Staff follow outdated division rules because the Logistics supplement drifted from group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Logistics supplement last aligned 2024 (shared accounts, vendor remote access)
existing_controls: Group policies 2026
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Logistics supplement; annual attestation

threat_event: A critical SaaS provider (ERP, payment service provider, identity) suffers an extended outage or breach
threat_source: Provider failure or attacker at the provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ERP tenant; one PSP with an untested secondary route; SaaS contracts without recovery objectives for some vendors
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 reviews; ERP replication; break-glass accounts
treatment_plan: Test the secondary PSP route; recovery objectives in ERP and TMS renewals; tier-1 vendor monitoring

threat_event: AI used in purchasing, fraud screening, and workforce decisions causes harm without adequate governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group AI Standard adopted 2026-05 after AI-001 automatic release went live; Logistics and Online Retail use cases unassessed
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D4; SYS-G6; Online Retail fraud model; labor management
existing_controls: Group AI council; AI inventory
treatment_plan: Group AI program conditions (P10)

threat_event: Consumer payment or personal data is stolen from Online Retail
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment page script controls on 1 of 3 brands; card data in call recordings; 5.8 million accounts
existing_controls: Hosted payment fields; annual ROC; WAF; ASV scans
treatment_plan: Script controls on all brands; purge and stop recording card data; web application testing

threat_event: DC automation is compromised or disrupted, stopping automated DCs and risking worker injury
threat_source: Attacker through vendor access or malware from the handheld network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Persistent vendor tunnels at 3 DCs; flat OT networks at 5 DCs; OT not monitored; PLC backups on laptops at 4 DCs
regulatory_driver: None (worker safety and continuity; P05 BP-LW03)
existing_controls: Lockout procedures; manual sortation lanes
treatment_plan: PAM-brokered vendor access; OT segmentation; OT monitoring; PLC backups in the vault

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects supplier or 3PL payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2,400 suppliers; bank changes verified by call-back but supplier mailboxes are outside group control
existing_controls: Call-back verification; segregation of duties; bank positive pay
treatment_plan: Supplier portal bank changes with MFA; anomaly rules on payment changes

threat_event: Covered telecommunications or video surveillance equipment is provided to a federal customer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1,900 SKUs without manufacturer of record; block only on federal orders
existing_controls: Screening list; hard block on federal orders
treatment_plan: Mandatory manufacturer of record; extend block to refurbished stock

threat_event: The group misses CCPA cybersecurity audit or risk assessment duties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No risk assessment started for sharing personal information; audit readiness not planned
affected_asset_or_process: Online Retail consumer data; group privacy program
existing_controls: Privacy program; consumer request handling
treatment_plan: Risk assessments by 2027-12-31; audit readiness review 2027

threat_event: Insiders misuse customer, seller, or employee personal data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad support access to seller bank data; large contact center workforce
existing_controls: Role-based access; SOC monitoring
treatment_plan: Restrict seller financial data to the verification team; monitoring rules

threat_event: Unsupported or inherited systems at acquired sites are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC-8 and DC-9 handhelds past support; shared logins
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D5 handhelds at DC-8 and DC-9
existing_controls: Network isolation of handheld SSIDs
treatment_plan: Replace handhelds; named sign-in

threat_event: A hurricane closes Florida operations (headquarters, DC-1, IC-1)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Headquarters, the largest DC, and an integration center in one region
existing_controls: Cloud-hosted systems; remote work; DC load balancing
treatment_plan: Shift volume to DC-4 and DC-6; IC-2 takes priority integration jobs

threat_event: Annual cybersecurity disclosure misstates governance or a material incident is filed late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure relies on division inputs with different maturity
existing_controls: Disclosure committee; Group CISO reporting
treatment_plan: Disclosure controls testing; tabletop includes a materiality decision

threat_event: 3PL client data is exposed through WMS console accounts without MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1,900 client users with passwords only
existing_controls: Lockout; SOC monitoring
treatment_plan: MFA for client users

threat_event: OEMs withdraw authorizations after gray-market sourcing is found in the channel
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broker purchases for commercial stock without risk review
existing_controls: Authorized-source preference
treatment_plan: Broker approval workflow; OEM reporting
owner: IT Distribution vice president of purchasing
